A systematic meta-analysis of genetic, regional, and production determinants of global pork quality

Code and model outputs - Shear Force

1 Loading packages and data

## load the packages
library(metafor)
library(orchaRd)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(openxlsx)
library(MuMIn)
library(glue)
library(rlang)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
## Load the functions from the script file
source("functions.R")
## Load the data for Shear Force
data_SF <- read.csv("SF.csv")

## Convert columns to appropriate numeric types
data_SF$Mean <- as.numeric(data_SF$Mean)
data_SF$SD <- as.numeric(data_SF$SD)
data_SF$Sample <- as.numeric(data_SF$Sample)
data_SF$Age <- as.numeric(data_SF$Age)
data_SF$Weight <- as.numeric(data_SF$Weight)
data_SF$Digestible_energy <- as.numeric(data_SF$Digestible_energy)
data_SF$Crude_protein <- as.numeric(data_SF$Crude_protein)
data_SF$Crude_fat <- as.numeric(data_SF$Crude_fat)
data_SF$Crude_fiber <- as.numeric(data_SF$Crude_fiber)
data_SF$Ash <- as.numeric(data_SF$Ash)
data_SF$Lys <- as.numeric(data_SF$Lys)
data_SF$Met_and_Cys <- as.numeric(data_SF$Met_and_Cys)
data_SF$Thr <- as.numeric(data_SF$Thr)
data_SF$Try <- as.numeric(data_SF$Try)
data_SF$Val <- as.numeric(data_SF$Val)
data_SF$Dry_matter <- as.numeric(data_SF$Dry_matter)
data_SF$Ca <- as.numeric(data_SF$Ca)
data_SF$P <- as.numeric(data_SF$P)
data_SF$Na <- as.numeric(data_SF$Na)

## Convert columns to factor types
data_SF$Position <- factor(data_SF$Position)
data_SF$Breed <- factor(data_SF$Breed)
data_SF$Class <- factor(data_SF$Class)
data_SF$Sex <- factor(data_SF$Sex)
data_SF$Region <- factor(data_SF$Region) 
data_SF$Aim <- factor(data_SF$Aim)
data_SF$Multiple_breeds <- factor(data_SF$Multiple_breeds)

## Calculate variance (rVar)
# rVar is the square of the standard error (SD/sqrt(Sample))
data_SF$rVar <- (data_SF$SD/sqrt(data_SF$Sample))^2

2 Testing random effects

## Run VCV matrix for all data
VCV_SF_AllData <- make_VCV_matrix(data_SF, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")

## Null model with VCV matrix:
# This model includes random effects for RowID (observation-level) and StudyID.
null_SF_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_SF_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_SF, method = "ML")
summary(null_SF_mod) #6973.8212            
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 853; method: ML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -3483.9106   4486.3118   6973.8212   6988.0675   6973.8495   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##               estim     sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1   53.2102   7.2945    853     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  371.2807  19.2686    414     no  StudyID 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 852) = 1256153.8246, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval    ci.lb    ci.ub      
##  44.6302  1.0055  44.3857  <.0001  42.6595  46.6010  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## Test whether Region should be a random effect:
# Adds Region as a random effect to the null model structure.
Re_SF_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_SF_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID,
                                     ~1 |Region), 
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_SF, method = "ML")

## Full model with fixed effects for Position, Breed, Region, and Class
SF_full_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_SF_AllData, 
                      mods = ~Position + Breed + Region + Class, 
                      random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID),
                      sparse = TRUE,
                      data = data_SF, method = "ML")
R2_Full <- round(r2_ml(SF_full_mod)*100, 2)
anova(SF_full_mod,null_SF_mod)
## 
##          df       AIC       BIC      AICc     logLik      LRT   pval           QE 
## Full    269 7041.8303 8319.2466 7290.9898 -3251.9151                   78595.8528 
## Reduced   3 6973.8212 6988.0675 6973.8495 -3483.9106 463.9909 <.0001 1256153.8246
## Model with Position as a fixed effect
SF_Position_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_SF_AllData, 
                          mods = ~Position,
                          random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                        ~1 |StudyID),
                          sparse = TRUE,
                          data = data_SF, method = "ML")
R2_Position <-round(r2_ml(SF_Position_mod)*100, 2)
anova(SF_Position_mod,null_SF_mod)
## 
##         df       AIC       BIC      AICc     logLik     LRT   pval           QE 
## Full    14 6957.2119 7023.6945 6957.7131 -3464.6059                 963546.5638 
## Reduced  3 6973.8212 6988.0675 6973.8495 -3483.9106 38.6093 <.0001 1256153.8246
## Model with Breed as a fixed effect
SF_Breed_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_SF_AllData,

R2_Breed <- round(r2_ml(SF_Breed_mod)*100, 2)
anova(SF_Breed_mod,null_SF_mod)

## Model with Region as a fixed effect
SF_Region_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_SF_AllData,

R2_Region <- round(r2_ml(SF_Region_mod)*100, 2)

## Model with Class as a fixed effect
SF_Class_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_SF_AllData, 
                       mods = ~Class,
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,

R2_Class <- round(r2_ml(SF_Class_mod)*100, 2)

##

## Reduced  3 6973.8212 6988.0675 6973.8495 -3483.9106 25.2274 0.0897 1256153.8246
## Create a table of R-squared values for models with moderators
R2_models_summary <- data.frame("Model" = c("Full",
                                     "Position",
                                     "Breed",
                                     "Region", 
                                     "Class"),
                         "R2" = c(R2_Full[1],
                                  R2_Position[1],
                                  R2_Breed[1],
                                  R2_Region[1], 
                                  R2_Class[1]))
R2_models_summary <- R2_models_summary %>% 
  transmute(Model = Model
            ,R2= round(R2,2))

colnames(R2_models_summary)[2] <- "$R^2(\\%)$"

R2_models_summary %>% 
  kable(format="html", escape=F, caption="Heterogeneity explained in the models with moderators") %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
  kable_styling(c("hover", "condensed"), full_width = F)

## Refit with REML for reporting in Manuscript
REML_SF_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_SF_AllData, 
                        random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                      ~1 |StudyID,
                                      ~1 |Region,
                                      # ~1 | Position, # Position was not better than null in initial test
                                      ~1 |Breed),
                        sparse = TRUE,
                        data = data_SF, method = "REML")
summary(REML_SF_mod)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 853; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -3471.1562   6942.3125   6952.3125   6976.0504   6952.3834   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##               estim     sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1   48.5724   6.9694    853     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  339.2916  18.4199    414     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3   36.8314   6.0689     54     no   Region 
## sigma^2.4   10.2018   3.1940    207     no    Breed 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 852) = 1256153.8246, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval    ci.lb    ci.ub      
##  43.9197  1.5379  28.5584  <.0001  40.9055  46.9339  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
# Calculate I-squared values
round(i2_ml(REML_SF_mod), 2)
##   I2_Total   I2_RowID I2_StudyID  I2_Region   I2_Breed 
##      99.95      11.16      77.98       8.46       2.34
# Calculate R-squared
round(r2_ml(REML_SF_mod)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.00          88.83
## Generate orchard plot for the REML model
p_REML_SF <- orchard_plot(REML_SF_mod,
                               group = "StudyID",  
                               xlab = "Mean Shear Force (N)", 
                               cb = FALSE,
                               angle = 0,
                               legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                               branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_REML_SF)

3 Meta-regression

3.1 Breed

## Filter data for breeds with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_SF_B3 <- data_SF %>%
  group_by(Breed) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered breed data
VCV_SF_B3_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_SF_B3, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")
## Define random structure
random_structure_breed <- list(~1 |RowID,
                               ~1 |StudyID,
                               ~1 |Region) 

# Model with intercept
Br_VCV_REML_SF_mod_int <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_SF_B3_Data,
  mods = ~ Breed,
  random = random_structure_breed,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_SF_B3)
summary(Br_VCV_REML_SF_mod_int)

res_SF_Br <- all_models(
  data        = data_SF_B3,
  vcv         = VCV_SF_B3_Data,
  yi_col      = "Mean",
  mod_name    = "Breed",
  random_list = random_structure_breed 
)

3.2 Class

## Filter data for Class with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_SF_Cl <- data_SF %>%
  group_by(Class) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered Class data
VCV_SF_Cl_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_SF_Cl, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")
## Define random structure
random_structure_class <- list(~1 |RowID,
                               ~1 |StudyID,

3.6 Age

## Filter data for complete cases of Age
data_SF_Age <- data_SF[complete.cases(data_SF$Age), ]

## Create VCV matrix for Age data
VCV_SF_Age_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_SF_Age, 
                                    V = "rVar", 
                                    cluster = "StudyID", 
                                    obs = "RowID")
## Define common random structure for continuous moderators
random_structure_continuous <- list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID,
                                    ~1 |Region,  
                                    ~1 |Breed)

## Run meta-regression for Age
res_SF_Age <- run_meta_ct(
  dat         = data_SF_Age,          
  mod_var     = "Age",
  random_list = random_structure_continuous, 
  plot_name   = "p_SF_Age",              
  x_lab       = "Age (Days)",
  y_lab       = "Mean Shear Force (N)" 
)

## Generate summary table for Age models
mods_list_age <- attr(res_SF_Age$best_model, "mods_list") 
aic_tab_age   <- res_SF_Age$aic_table                   

tbl_SF_Age <- model_summary_tbl(
  mods_list_age, aic_tab_age, 
  lin_coef  = "mod_c",              
  quad_coef = "mod_c2"
)
## Display summary table for Age models
html_table_age <- tbl_SF_Age %>% 
  kable(format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")  
print(html_table_age)

## Run meta-regression for Crude fat

  dat         = data_SF_Cfat,          
  mod_var     = "Crude_fat",
  random_list = random_structure_continuous, 
  plot_name   = "p_SF_Cfat",              
  x_lab       = "Crude fat (% of DM)", 
  y_lab       = "Mean Shear Force (N)" 
)

  lin_coef  = "mod_c",              
  quad_coef = "mod_c2"
)

4 Publication bias and sensitivity analyses

4.1 Decline effect (Publication Year)

## Define random structure
random_structure_Ye <- list(~1 |RowID,
                            ~1 |StudyID,
                            ~1 |Region,  
                            ~1 |Breed) 

## Model with Publication Year (Years) as moderator
Ye_VCV_REML_SF_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_SF_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Years,
   random = random_structure_Ye, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_SF)
summary(Ye_VCV_REML_SF_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 853; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -3465.1444   6930.2889   6942.2889   6970.7673   6942.3884   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##               estim     sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1   48.5113   6.9650    853     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  337.2706  18.3649    414     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3   35.4097   5.9506     54     no   Region 
## sigma^2.4   10.4236   3.2286    207     no    Breed 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 851) = 1249592.9865, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 851) = 3.4719, p-val = 0.0628
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##            estimate        se     tval   df    pval       ci.lb     ci.ub    
## intrcpt  -1207.1909  671.4462  -1.7979  851  0.0725  -2525.0755  110.6938  . 
## Years        0.6196    0.3325   1.8633  851  0.0628     -0.0331    1.2723  . 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Ye_VCV_REML_SF_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.78          88.85
## Bubble plot for decline effect
p_Ye_VCV_REML_SF <- orchaRd::bubble_plot(Ye_VCV_REML_SF_mod_int, 
                                  mod = "Years",
                                  group = "StudyID",
                                  xlab = "Publication year",
                                  ylab = "Mean Shear Force (N)", 
                                  g = TRUE)
p_Ye_VCV_REML_SF <- p_Ye_VCV_REML_SF + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2014, 2024, by = 2))
print(p_Ye_VCV_REML_SF)

4.2 Aim (Whether the aim of study was meat quality)

## Define random structure
random_structure_aim <- list(~1 |RowID,
                             ~1 |StudyID,
                             ~1 |Region,  
                             ~1 |Breed)

#Model with intercept
Ai_VCV_REML_SF_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_SF_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Aim,
   random = random_structure_aim, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_SF)
summary(Ai_VCV_REML_SF_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 853; method: REML)
## 
##     logLik    Deviance         AIC         BIC        AICc   
## -3466.6211   6933.2422   6945.2422   6973.7207   6945.3417   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##               estim     sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1   48.5504   6.9678    853     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  339.9172  18.4368    414     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3   36.3862   6.0321     54     no   Region 
## sigma^2.4   10.2642   3.2038    207     no    Breed 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 851) = 1229517.0268, p-val < .0001

## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 851) = 0.4944, p-val = 0.4822
## 
## Model Results:

## 
## ---

#Model without intercept for plotting
Ai_VCV_REML_SF_mod <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_SF_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Aim -1,
   random = random_structure_aim, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_SF)
## Orchard plot for Aim moderator
p_Ai_VCV_REML_SF <- orchard_plot(Ai_VCV_REML_SF_mod, 
                                   mod = "Aim",  
                                   group = "StudyID",  
                                   xlab = "Mean Shear Force (N)", 
                                   cb = FALSE,
                                   angle = 0,
                                   legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                                   branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_Ai_VCV_REML_SF)

4.3 Multiple_breeds (Whether multiple breeds were involved)

                            ~1 |StudyID,
                            ~1 |Region,
